source: Shopify Admin GraphQL API 2026-10 via the Shopify connector (read-only queries; no mutations)
scope: shopLocales (all, published and unpublished) and the web presences that use them.
notes: Only one locale is enabled: English, primary and published. No alternate languages, so there is nothing for a language selector to list.
Store-level translations (Translate & Adapt) were not exported; with no second locale there are none to apply on the storefront.
